name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-document-lifecycle-version-review
title: Document Lifecycle and Version Review
longDescription: This SPFx React web part provides a bounded, read-only review aid for document-library and list rows.

It shows file links, source, content type, owner, dates, version details, size, checkout and approval or publish values when SharePoint supplies them, plus stale, major-version and review-state signals.
All network access uses SharePoint REST GET requests through the SPFx HTTP client. This is a review aid, not an authoritative compliance or records-management report.
